items.name: Suezmax newbuild tankers under construction
items.claim: Teekay Tankers' fleet includes two Suezmax tanker newbuildings still under construction, alongside 34 delivered double-hull tankers.
items.source_excerpt: Teekay Tankers has a fleet of 34 double-hull tankers (including 14 Suezmax tankers, 18 Aframax / LR2 tankers, and two Suezmax tanker newbuildings), and also has three time chartered-in oil tankers.

notes: Q2 2026 results release is a dividend-declaration notice with a boilerplate fleet description; the two Suezmax newbuildings are the only forward-pipeline figure disclosed there.
